comment: Hand-kept aliases for institutions (curated tier, matched at 0.97). Each name is an exact IPEDS INSTNM or ROR display name, found exactly once, or the build fails. A collision with another entity's key also fails the build unless vocab/curated/ambiguous-ok.json lists it. An alias here names one campus, so it is never a name a whole system or several institutions answer to: those are in institution-shared-names.json (CMU, UMD, TAMU, LSU, UMN, Texas A&M and Arizona State University were moved there), and a bare system name maps to a campus only as a flagship, on the owner's word. An acronym kept here is reported in vocab/reports/collisions.txt with the other institutions the full sources spell the same way.

institutions.name: The University of Texas at Austin
The University of Texas at Dallas
The University of Texas at Arlington
Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University
Columbia University in the City of New York
